```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, roster_pos) |> label_endings()
study_pop <- filter(endings, group != "Position not recorded")
state_fill <- ending_palette()
route_colour <- c(
  Drafted = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
  `Signed undrafted` = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]],
  `Either NFL route` = "#374151"
)
rec_lines <- c(`Matched recruiting record` = "solid", `No matched recruiting record` = "dashed")
horizon <- 3L
min_curve <- 30
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
rec_routes <- route_incidence(study_pop, "recruited")
rec_gap <- rec_routes |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  select(route, recruited, estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = recruited, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(
    ratio = `Matched recruiting record` / `No matched recruiting record`,
    y = 100 * `Matched recruiting record`
  )

p <- rec_routes |>
  filter(n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "All positions, %s, by season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      tolower(recruited), time, pct(estimate), tolower(route), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, colour = route, fill = route, linetype = recruited, group = recruited)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(state, recruited, time)), size = 2.6) +
  geom_label(
    data = rec_gap,
    aes(x = horizon, y = y, label = sprintf("%.1fx", ratio)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.15,
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 5.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "#B45309",
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~route, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = route_colour, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = route_colour, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rec_lines, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.2))) +
  labs(
    title = "NFL routes with and without a matched recruiting record",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Solid: matched record; dashed: none. Labels: how many times as often by season %s",
      horizon
    ),
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = NULL,
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "recruiting-record-gap", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
ci <- ending_incidence(endings) |> filter(group != "Position not recorded")
thin <- thin_position_groups(ci, horizon, min_curve)
rec_routes_group <- study_pop |>
  mutate(cell = paste(group, recruited, sep = "|")) |>
  route_incidence("cell") |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cell, "|", names = c("group", "recruited")) |>
  filter(!group %in% thin) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, position_group_levels()))
p_group <- rec_routes_group |>
  filter(n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s, by season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, tolower(recruited), time, pct(estimate), tolower(route), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, colour = route, fill = route, linetype = recruited, group = recruited)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state, recruited)), size = 2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(group), cols = vars(route), labeller = labeller(group = label_wrap_gen(10))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = route_colour, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = route_colour, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rec_lines) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "The recruiting-record gap by position group",
    subtitle = "Cumulative percent of eligible players by NFL route, matched recruiting record (solid) or not (dashed)",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative percent",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Seasons with fewer than ", min_curve, " players at risk are omitted.",
      if (length(thin)) paste0(" Omitted groups: ", paste(tolower(thin), collapse = ", "), ".") else "",
      " Hover a point for its interval."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "#374151", linewidth = 1.1), keywidth = unit(4, "lines")))
card_interactive(p_group, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 16)
```
